notes.title: Message from Devs
notes.notes:
A big 'Thank You!' from everyone on the Hit team to all of you for playing our game. We have a few updates, so we'll jump right in. 

First, Hit is a game of deception and trust, so it's its most fun when you're playing with people you know. You'll need at least three people to get any secrets floating around, so that's the minimum required players in a lobby to start a game. 

Also Hit does not have dedicated servers and relies on players to create their own lobbies for others to join. We're a team of students, and this helped us to release the game completely for free.

We built Hit over 12 months during graduate school, between other class work and responsibilities, through internships and graduation. Needless to say, it's our passion project, and we're honored and humbled that so many of you are playing. We are grateful for all the players and feedback we have received since launch, and we'll continue to work on the game in our spare time to make it even better for you guys. But bear with us as these updates become less frequent--we've all graduated now, and most of the team has moved on to full-time jobs at other companies. 

Once again, we're so glad you're playing, and look forward to continued updates, and your excellent feedback. Thank you!

notes.title: Fixes to Hosting and Joining
notes.notes: We've added some fixes that should make it easier to host and join games. Because the game is completely free, Hit uses non-dedicated servers, so players must host games for others to play. In addition, games now need at least 3 players in a lobby to start. Thanks again for your patience and support.

notes.title: We recommend using a controller for HIT.
notes.notes:
Hey again, everyone!

While we work through some launch-day difficulties, we'd like to clear up our controller situation. 

This game can be played with either a controller or a keyboard but we recommend using a controller. :) 

Our menus can be navigated fully with either a controller or keyboard but it's easier with a controller because our menu has to be navigated with the arrow keys on a keyboard and is not optimized to use the mouse. 

Sorry for any confusion this has caused. 

Love, 
The Hit Team

notes.title: Problems joining HIT!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we know you're having some problems joining our game right now and we're very sorry to hear about that. We are working on it as quick as we can.  

We know this is an inconvenience and we apologize for it but would like to thank the awesome Steam Community for bringing this error to our attention. 

We will keep all of you posted as we come to a solution.
